boards.hardware: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, 800x480 monochrome e-paper, ES8311, NS4150B, TG28 PMIC, three-way key
boards.identify: Waveshare 3.97-inch e-paper board with three-way side key, BOOT/PWR buttons and USB-C
boards.flash_port: Native ESP32-S3 USB-C (GPIO19/20). Hold BOOT while reconnecting USB for download mode.
boards.use: WiFi hotspot provisioning, activation, bound-Agent conversation list/create/select and realtime voice
boards.notes: Hotspot WavePaper397-XXXX. Center: call; hold center: menu; Up/Down: volume or menu selection; BOOT: back/end. Device acceptance pending. Platform product ID 20, product key esp32-s3-epaper-397, platform name waveShare-ESP32-S3-ePaper-3.97. Use ESP-IDF 5.5.x; the shared ES8311 driver is not compatible with IDF 6.1.
